title: sales
text:
sales

maria_sales: Quick heads up — found an issue with the new pricing table v2026.03 where the POC discount isn't being applied for Dedicated commit quotes to Acme Health. This affects the PO we sent this morning. @alex_dealdesk @sylvia_revops can we fast-track a fix and a corrected invoice?

alex_dealdesk: Sorry, saw this just now. Is this the template mapping bug (POC discount field not flowing to line items) or a calc issue? How many seats / monthly commit?

maria_sales: It's the template. Looks like `discount.type: poc` isn't getting translated to `line_items[].discount_pct`. Affects 3-month POC for 2x A100 slots. ~ $24k ARR, ~$6k over 3 months.

raj_engineering: tagging in case there's any contractual SLA implication if we change the already-sent PO. If customer signed we need a credit + corrected invoice. We should avoid touching commit accounting. 

alex_dealdesk: Understood. We can do a one-off credit and reissue the invoice. Two asks: 1) quick approval from RevOps for credit, 2) confirmation from Billing we can reissue without breaking commit commitments. @sylvia_revops? :pray:

sylvia_revops: I can approve a corrective credit for POC promo — that's covered by our POC concession policy. Need: the original invoice ID, the corrected line items, and a short explanation to attach to the credit memo. Also add a note that this is a POC-specific concession (not a permanent rate change).

maria_sales: Original invoice: INV-2026-7981. Proposed corrected line items (draft):
```
- Dedicated GPU (A100 x2) — term 3m — qty 1 — price $18,000
- POC discount — -30% — amount -$5,400
- Subtotal: $12,600
- Tax: $1,134
- Total: $13,734
```
Can we create a credit for $5,400 and reissue to $13,734?

billing-bot: Invoice draft for correction created: INV-DRAFT-2026-3472 (status: pending). Please confirm authorization code `AUTH-POC-22` in comments to proceed.

alex_dealdesk: I sign off on the credit and reissue for this POC. Approving provisional exception under "POC concession". Authorization: `AUTH-POC-22`. Adding this to deal desk tracker. :white_check_mark:

raj_engineering: From infra side — no SLA change needed. Confirmed no commit metrics will be altered by issuing a credit and reissue. :thumbsup:

maria_sales: Amazing, thanks all. I'll update the Acme contact and resubmit. Sylvia — please attach the short note recommending we mark this as a non-recurring concession. I'll send the customer-facing note after billing publishes the corrected invoice.

sylvia_revops: Got it. Attaching note and flagging for audit. Will process credit and reissue before EOD PST.

maria_sales: Will follow up if the customer needs a signed amendment. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
